## The character

**Name:**
**Original or fan art of something:**

If it is someone else's character, please keep the pack in your own
`~/.config/clawdline/mascots/` and post it as a gist instead — a link in the gallery is
fine, but shipping it in this repo is not something the project can take on.

## Checklist

- [ ] `python3 tools/validate-pack.py Resources/mascots/<name>.json` passes
- [ ] All five routines present: `pop`, `idle`, `typing`, `dance`, `cheer`
- [ ] Looked at it: `open "clawdline://snapshot?path=/tmp/m.png&routine=dance&t=0.3"`
- [ ] Screenshot or GIF attached below
